beginner.title: Get started with Sportscode
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Sportscode, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up your team
beginner.outcome: You can: set up teams, athletes and seasons

beginner.title: Capture
beginner.outcome: You can: record or import sessions and matches
beginner.practice: Upload and organise one match or session

intermediate.title: Tag and analyse
intermediate.outcome: You can: turn footage or data into insight
intermediate.practice: Tag one match and build a clip reel

intermediate.title: Feedback to athletes
intermediate.outcome: You can: give feedback athletes use
intermediate.practice: Send three athletes their clips with notes

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Sportscode
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Sportscode distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Sportscode
expert.outcome: You can: use Sportscode's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Season-long insight
expert.outcome: You can: track development over a season

expert.title: Integrate Sportscode into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Sportscode with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Sportscode to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Sportscode well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Sportscode" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
